title: Dose Response Lab
learning_goals: Differentiate 1-compartment vs 2-compartment distribution phases and multi-exponential decay.
Compare oral absorption kinetics against zero-order IV infusion and instantaneous IV bolus.
Apply allometric weight scaling and calculate CrCl renal impairment dose adjustments.
Forecast peak concentration (Cmax) and time in target therapeutic window.
Link plasma concentration to physiological effect using sigmoid Emax pharmacodynamics.
Analyze multi-dose accumulation ratios and steady-state kinetics.

rules.text: Administered dose must not exceed the maximum recommended adult single dose from drug specifications.
rules.hint: Stay within single-dose upper ceiling to prevent immediate acute toxicity.

rules.text: Patients with renal impairment (CrCl < 60 mL/min) receiving renally cleared drugs require dose reduction.
rules.hint: Adjust dose or extend interval tau when CrCl indicates renal clearance impairment (<60 mL/min).

rules.text: Selected administration route must be compatible with drug bioavailability.
rules.hint: Select approved therapeutic agent and matching route from clinical formulary.

rules.text: Patient parameters must remain within adult boundary limits (Age 18-90, Weight 40-150 kg, CrCl 15-150 mL/min).
rules.hint: Configure adult patient covariates within safe ranges (age 18-90, weight 40-150 kg).

rules.text: Narrow therapeutic index drugs require at least 3 blood sampling observation timepoints.
rules.hint: Schedule sampling points across absorption, Cmax peak, and terminal elimination phases.

rules.text: Intravenous infusions must not be administered in under 15 minutes (< 0.25h) to avoid adverse reactions.
rules.hint: Ensure IV infusion duration is at least 15 minutes (0.25h) to avoid rapid infusion reactions.

rules.text: Enter predicted peak concentration and target window duration before executing simulation.
rules.hint: Formulate scientific prediction of Cmax and therapeutic window time before simulation run.

rules.text: Simulated Cmax must not exceed the toxic concentration threshold.
rules.hint: Optimize regimen so steady-state trough and peak remain inside target therapeutic band.

select_patient: Select an adult patient profile and confirm baseline weight, age, and renal status.
select_drug: Select drug and valid route from the clinical formulary (e.g. Paracetamol oral or Gentamicin IV).
set_dose: Specify dose within safety boundaries and configure infusion duration or dosing intervals.
check_renal: Check creatinine clearance (CrCl); if < 60 mL/min, confirm renal dose adjustment.
set_sampling: Choose blood sampling schedule (e.g. 0-24h monitoring) to capture Cmax and terminal elimination.
predict_window: Record your scientific prediction for peak concentration and duration in target window.
run_simulation: Run the deterministic simulation engine and examine concentration and effect curves.
debrief_pkpd: Analyze observed Cmax, AUC, and time-in-target window before finalizing session report.

common_mistakes.remedy: Patients with CrCl < 60 mL/min clear aminoglycosides slowly; reduce dose by 50% or extend interval.
Infuse vancomycin over at least 60 minutes to prevent red man syndrome.
